Q: Installation path of Visual Studio 2022 vs 2026 A:

For VS Insider builds (AFAIK) you'll need to use either the -prerelease or -all flags; while using -latest means only 1 result will be returned (so an "old" prerelease install would be hidden by a more recent normal public build); (interestingly, without using -all then botched-but-working installations might not be listed either)

As documented in vswhere /?:

-all: Finds instances in complete, launchable, and incomplete states. By default, only instances in a complete state - no errors or reboot required - are searched.

-prerelease: Also searches prereleases. By default, only releases are searched.

-latest: Return only the newest version and last installed.

So you'll probably be fine with -prerelease -latest.

You might also want to specify -nologo and -nocolor to ease parsing with CMD's for.

vswhere -latest -prerelease -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -nologo -nocolor

i.e.:

for /f "usebackq tokens=1* delims=: " %%i in (`vswhere -latest -prerelease -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -nologo -nocolor`) do (
  if /i "%%i"=="installationPath" set InstallDir=%%j
)

BTW, your for loop will keep on iterating after the first match, which is a bit silly and results in extraneous output; you can use a nested if and some goto jumps to exit early; also using @ to disable redundant local-echo on a per-line basis also helps the UX:

for /f "usebackq tokens=1* delims=: " %%i in (`vswhere.exe -latest -prerelease -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -nologo -nocolor`) do (
    @if /i "%%i"=="installationPath" (
        @set InstallDir=%%j
        @goto foundIt
    )
)

@echo Did not locate VS.
exit /b 1

:foundIt
@echo InstallDir: %InstallDir%
exit /b 0

Q: Markdown with Mermaid/PlantUML preview not working in Android Studio? A:

This is expected behavior, not really a bug.

Android Studio is based on IntelliJ IDEA, but it doesn’t ship with the exact same Markdown preview features. In particular, the Markdown plugin in Android Studio is more limited, and things like Mermaid or PlantUML rendering inside Markdown are not fully supported there, even if the plugin installs without errors.

In IntelliJ IDEA (especially Ultimate), the Markdown plugin has better integration and supports extensions like Mermaid or PlantUML when additional plugins are enabled. Android Studio focuses on Android development, so some of these integrations are missing or partially implemented.

A few things you can check:

  1. Make sure the Markdown plugin is actually enabled
    Go to Settings → Plugins and confirm that “Markdown” is enabled. In some Android Studio versions, it’s bundled but disabled.

  2. Verify plugin compatibility
    The Mermaid plugin you installed is primarily built and tested for IntelliJ IDEA. Even if Android Studio lets you install it, it doesn’t guarantee full support in the Markdown preview.

  3. Check the preview mode
    In Android Studio, try switching the Markdown preview engine (if available) between “Built-in” and “JavaFX”. Some rendering features depend on that, but even then Mermaid/PlantUML often won’t render.

  4. Try PlantUML plugin separately
    For PlantUML, the dedicated “PlantUML integration” plugin sometimes works, but usually only in .puml files, not inside Markdown blocks.

Realistically, if you need Mermaid/PlantUML rendering inside Markdown:

  • Use IntelliJ IDEA for editing those docs

  • Or use an external tool like VS Code with Mermaid/PlantUML extensions

  • Or preview via a web-based renderer (GitHub, markdown preview tools, etc.)

So the short answer is: Android Studio is not feature-parity with IntelliJ IDEA for Markdown rendering, and those plugins don’t fully work there even if they install.

Q: python-docx how can i save docx to the specific path? A:

from docx import Document

# 1. Membuat dokumen baru

doc = Document()

# 2. Menambahkan Title

doc.add_heading('MAKALAH (VERSI REVISI)', 0)

# 3. Menambahkan Pendahuluan

doc.add_paragraph('Judul: Hukum Warisan dalam Islam\n\nDokumen ini telah diperbaiki dari segi ejaan, tata bahasa, dan struktur.')

# 4. Menambahkan Heading 1 (Catatan Kesalahan)

doc.add_heading('Catatan Kesalahan per Halaman', 1)

doc.add_paragraph(

"Halaman 2:\n- 'terimakasin' → 'terima kasih'\n\n"

"Halaman 3:\n- 'Definisih' → 'Definisi'\n\n"

"Halaman 4:\n- 'Isalam' → 'Islam'\n\n"

"Halaman 8:\n- 'AL-Qur’an' → 'Al-Qur’an'\n- 'bidup' → 'hidup'\n\n"

"Halaman 15:\n- Kalimat tidak lengkap pada bagian kesimpulan\n"

)

# 5. Menambahkan Heading 1 (Perbaikan Umum)

doc.add_heading('Perbaikan Umum', 1)

doc.add_paragraph(

"- Memperbaiki typo dan ejaan\n"

"- Merapikan struktur kalimat\n"

"- Konsistensi huruf kapital\n"

"- Perbaikan istilah ilmiah\n"

)

# 6. Menyimpan file

file_path = "Makalah_Revisi.docx" # Disesuaikan agar bisa langsung dijalankan

doc.save(file_path)

print(f"File be

rhasil disimpan di: {file_path}")
